target.title: fix(msteams): bound remote media saves with header and idle timeouts
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

QQBot remote media downloads had **no body-read idle timeout** on any code path. If a QQ CDN host returned response headers successfully but then stalled mid-body (network congestion, server-side hang, TCP keep-alive without data), the download would hang indefinitely.

Three affected code paths on `main` before this fix:

| # | File | Path | Issue |
|---|------|------|-------|
| 1 | `extensions/qqbot/src/engine/utils/file-utils.ts` | `downloadFile()` → `fetchMedia()` | Passed `responseHeaderTimeoutMs: 120_000` but omitted `readIdleTimeoutMs` |
| 2 | `extensions/qqbot/src/bridge/bootstrap.ts` | `fetchMedia()` → `readRemoteMediaBuffer()` | Forwarded `responseHeaderTimeoutMs` but dropped `readIdleTimeoutMs` from the pass-through |
| 3 | `extensions/qqbot/src/bridge/bootstrap.ts` | `downloadFile()` → `readRemoteMediaBuffer()` | Passed no timeouts at all — only `{ url, filePathHint }` |

In `src/media/fetch.ts`, `responseBodyChunks()` only guards the read when `readIdleTimeoutMs` is present; otherwise it falls through to `await reader.read()` with no timeout, so a stalled body blocks forever.

## Why This Change Was Made

Wire `readIdleTimeoutMs: 30_000` (plus the existing `responseHeaderTimeoutMs: 120_000`) through all three QQBot media paths and the `FetchMediaOptions` pass-through, matching the timeout policy already used by Mattermost, Zalo, and Tlon media fetches.

## User Impact

**Before:** A QQ CDN host that returned headers then stalled mid-body could hang a QQBot media download forever.

**After:** Stalled media bodies fail closed after the 30s idle budget with a clear `Media download stalled: no data received for Nms` error, releasing the connection.

## Evidence

- Changed: `extensions/qqbot/src/bridge/bootstrap.ts`, `extensions/qqbot/src/engine/adapter/types.ts`, `extensions/qqbot/src/engine/utils/file-utils.ts` (+ tests)
- Production caller path: QQBot `downloadFile` / `fetchMedia` → `readRemoteMediaBuffer({ readIdleTimeoutMs })` → `readResponseWithLimit(..., { chunkTimeoutMs })`

## Real behavior proof

### Behavior or issue addressed

QQBot media downloads now idle-timeout a stalled response body instead of hanging forever.

### Canonical reachability path

QQBot `downloadFile` → `readRemoteMediaBuffer({ url, readIdleTimeoutMs: 30_000 })` → `readResponseWithLimit(res, maxBytes, { chunkTimeoutMs })` (`src/media/fetch.ts:643`).

### Real environment tested

Real HTTP transport: a local `node:http` server on `127.0.0.1` that sends `image/png` headers plus one body chunk and then never sends another chunk or ends the response. The production `readRemoteMediaBuffer` (from `openclaw/plugin-sdk/media-runtime` — the exact function the QQBot fix passes `readIdleTimeoutMs` into) is driven against that live socket, following the repo's own `fetch.test.ts` real-transport pattern (public-looking `lookupFn` so the SSRF guard passes, `fetchImpl` connecting to the local server). Node v22.23.1.

### Exact steps or command run after this patch

```bash
# Real HTTP server sends media headers + one chunk then stalls; drive the
# production media reader against it (idle budget 300ms):
node --import tsx scripts/proof-qqbot-media-idle-timeout.mts

# Supplemental focused regressions:
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs extensions/qqbot/src/bridge/bootstrap.test.ts extensions/qqbot/src/engine/utils/file-utils.test.ts --reporter=dot
```

### Evidence after fix

Real HTTP stall (production media reader against a live socket):

```text
  ok: stalled media read rejected (not hung) — elapsed=496ms
  ok: media read terminated (bounded, not infinite) — elapsed=496ms
  ok: failure surfaced as MediaFetchError — Failed to fetch media from http://127.0.0.1:52599/stall: Media download stalled: no data received for 300ms
  ok: unbounded media body read still hanging after 2000ms — state=still-hanging
  ok: completing media body read intact — bytes=7

ALL PROOF ASSERTIONS PASSED
```

### Observed result after fix

Against a real stalled `image/png` socket, `readRemoteMediaBuffer` fails closed in ~496ms with `Media download stalled: no data received for 300ms` and releases the connection. The negative control — an unbounded `arrayBuffer()` on the same socket — is still unresolved after a 2000ms observation window, confirming the pre-fix hang. A well-behaved completing body still reads intact.

### What was not tested

Live stall against a real QQ CDN endpoint.

### Fix classification

bugfix — timeout/hang

## AI Assistance

AI-assisted. Author reviewed the QQBot media timeout pass-through and caller-path proof output.
